title: test(research): certify the V45 closed native endpoint cone
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This finite conditional audit reconstructs the complete frozen PR2979 emitted source sequence, then checks the closed value/chart/lifetime dependency cone for helper249/private953 and every native class it reaches, for both final providers and orientations. The normalized helper endpoint is its own original input and private953 is zero immediately before free; the paired physical wrapper factor is F7/inverse F7.

Per provider, the cone reaches 8,902 forward and 12,357 inverse-transpose events out of 22,748. These include 2,819/2,601 native events in 2,039/1,790 classes. All 7,658 class checks include all 512 columns and global phase, with every event associated to an exact identity receipt. Two independently implemented closure algorithms, reverse demand and forward SSA, agree against handwritten normative controls.

Physical rational scalar/COPY/CLEAR and known-zero allocation contracts, every peer-private return/reuse obligation, physical ownership/final packing/storage/precision/tape, and whole-supplier/outer/all-size/compiler admission remain open. No new supplier, cost, κ, selected record, independent human review or proof-kernel theorem is claimed. Only one isolated research package is added.

## Task and overlap

Task `independent-moment`, priority revision 6, persisted seed 78; scope **refined**. Base `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`; frozen construction [PR2979](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2979) at `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576`.

The initial joint-group/single-change and fixed-parent invoice slices already overlap PR2993/3014, so this takes [PR3008](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3008)'s released full-peer dependency handoff instead. [PR3006](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3006), `1432a43a331ec857f45093a1d6e16acdbe9849e2`, checked selected normalized endpoint covectors and seven native recipes. PR3008, `948a997eba1aaf13d04e2b52edf70404860d19dc`, bound 73 directly touching events. This package independently reconstructs the full source sequence and adds the complete causal peer/native chart closure, with full-payload orientation-aware caching. It imports neither predecessor checker; the frozen producers and credited separate exact kernel are reused.

Canonical Discussion2612 and the latest100 updated open PR bodies were refreshed, followed by the latest30 all-state PRs through3036 immediately before publication. Main remains at the base pin. Later word/packing compositions are separate and are not independently admitted here. This bounded coverage does not guarantee novelty against unpublished work or arbitrary diffs.

## Validation

Exact head `c7d0d7be056ba77fda1c168641b2bcffb10cf43d`, tree `952218dc7ccd0334a4c7c82c4f14f6452c3ce939`; 17 files, all under `research/rank7-v45-native-cone-seed78/`.

Supplied-artifact all-class checks passed, followed by the unmodified registered default cold replay in **599.18 seconds total**. Both providers reproduced the committed deterministic certificates. CPython3.12.14/NumPy2.3.5, isolated optimized warnings-as-errors checker interpreters, no dependency installation. Metadata/Git pins, source/code stability, AST compilation/no assertions/function size, staged whitespace and separate internal static review passed. [VALIDATION.json](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c7d0d7be056ba77fda1c168641b2bcffb10cf43d/research/rank7-v45-native-cone-seed78/VALIDATION.json) distinguishes actual execution modes and retains receipt/code/source hashes. Only explanatory documentation and the validation record changed after cold replay; checker/source/certificate bytes are unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-v45-native-cone-seed78
```

Complete source binding checks exact warp matrices, center containment, FULL cleanup and private lifetimes. Semantic mutations bypass hashes: an actual peer warp crosses an ADD while the old direct projection/clocks stay unchanged; wrong peer native phase/character rejects with an explicit Gaussian basis witness; conjugation differs from adjoint. The same-rank center control is explicitly a **derived center-only fixture**. Eight normative graph positives, a missing-edge mutant and fifteen oracle input guards distinguish closure agreement from decoder correctness.

Full selected-result cold replay, Lean, Docker and hosted CI are unclaimed; Ruff was unavailable locally. Finite Python evidence and a conditional composition argument are not a full multiplication theorem.

## Credit

Credit Marius-Paul Dumitrean for PR2979; Nick Petalas for PR2993/3006/3008 and the released handoff; the retained transport/native/extraction authors and Sagar Thakrar's separate exact kernel. Full lineage and source/license pins are in README/SOURCES, including the retained PR2226 notice. ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a separate internal oracle implementation and static reviews; no independent human review. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

[Package follow-ups](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c7d0d7be056ba77fda1c168641b2bcffb10cf43d/research/rank7-v45-native-cone-seed78/README.md#open-next-questions): seed all actual peer-private free obligations to check ancillary reuse, then join the local execution with PR2987's actual final fill and complete physical invoice. A peer's later free need not be a dependency of these two chosen roots; scalar realization, backing ownership, precision/tape and whole-supplier contracts still block admission.
